title: Minegun Point blank:Jelly
description: The addon adds some weapons in the style of vanilla minecraft
body: I'm creating a set based on the Metro game series, and I'm tired of people telling me that it's not suitable for Minecraft because it's too round. Here are some square Minecraft-style weapons! Take a bucket, put it on your head, grab a chicken, and get going! This add-on includes 4 weapons, 1 armor, and 1 grenade.
